mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 54 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are currently under a Third Quarter moon.

October is National Community Planning Month, a time to thank our dedicated Planning and Development Department. Also, please be aware that a portion of Highway M will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road work.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, the Dane County Farmers' Market tomorrow, and the World Dairy Expo coming up on October 4.
In our weekly police report, on September 21, officers identified and cited an individual for the retail theft of candy from a store on East Verona Avenue.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and the restaurant will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
